verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says it connects engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team, with timeline views and partner-team request forms. The evidence never explicitly describes dependency tracking (dependency links, dependency maps, or blocker visualization across teams), so that core part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit cross-team dependency linking or visualization documentation, cross-project dependency views or reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
Make it easy for partner teams to submit requests and track progress with forms.
